summary: Only KYMCO Ionex could be checked on official pages; eMOVING, Aeon, PGO, eReady, SYM and Yamaha sites were not reachable. Ionex's calculator lists CoolOne (light-class, about NT$49.8k), i-One Air (green plate, about NT$59.8k) and i-One (white plate, about NT$69.8k). These are internal calculator fields, not a printed list price, so confirm the shop price. The headline NT$39,200 for the i-One Fly Techno is a September 2025 New Taipei example that stacks four subsidies (8,000 + 3,600 + 10,000 + 15,000) on a NT$75,800 list price, and it requires scrapping an old scooter. Every Ionex swap model needs a monthly plan of NT$318 or more even at zero km; at full use that is roughly NT$1.5/km on the 318 plan. The only no-fee home-charged Ionex model is the Mint, a 25 km/h micro vehicle needing a plate. Gogoro had 87% of July 2026 registrations; Kymco 113, Yamaha 144, Aeon 92, eMoving 53. Kymco's best seller, the i-One Air, sold 57 in July. Dealer and service coverage for non-Gogoro brands is thin.
